comment: ReasoningBank-Enhanced Claude Code Settings - Copy sections to .claude/settings.json

hooks.command: cat | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' | tr '\n' '\0' | xargs -0 -I {} bash -c 'CMD="{}"; PATTERNS=$(npx hive-flow@alpha memory query "$CMD" --reasoningbank --limit 2 --format json 2>/dev/null || echo "{}"); if echo "$PATTERNS" | jq -e ".results | length > 0" > /dev/null 2>&1; then COUNT=$(echo "$PATTERNS" | jq ".results | length"); echo "📚 Found $COUNT ReasoningBank pattern(s)" >&2; fi; npx hive-flow@alpha hooks pre-command --command "$CMD" --validate-safety true'

cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.path // empty' | tr '\n' '\0' | xargs -0 -I {} bash -c 'FILE="{}"; if [ -n "$FILE" ]; then EXT="${FILE##*.}"; PATTERNS=$(npx hive-flow@alpha memory query "$EXT code patterns" --namespace code --reasoningbank --limit 2 2>/dev/null || echo ""); if [ -n "$PATTERNS" ]; then echo "📚 Loaded $EXT patterns from ReasoningBank" >&2; fi; fi; npx hive-flow@alpha hooks pre-edit --file "$FILE" --auto-assign-agents true'

hooks.comment: Store successful bash patterns in ReasoningBank
hooks.command: cat | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' | tr '\n' '\0' | xargs -0 -I {} bash -c 'CMD="{}"; EXIT_CODE=$(jq -r ".result.exit_code // \"1\"" 2>/dev/null); if [ "$EXIT_CODE" = "0" ]; then KEY="cmd_$(echo -n "$CMD" | md5sum 2>/dev/null | cut -d" " -f1 || echo $(date +%s))"; DESC="Successful: $CMD"; npx hive-flow@alpha memory store "$KEY" "$DESC" --namespace commands --reasoningbank --confidence 0.6 2>/dev/null; fi; npx hive-flow@alpha hooks post-command --command "$CMD" --track-metrics true'

hooks.comment: Store code patterns after successful edits
hooks.command: cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.path // empty' | tr '\n' '\0' | xargs -0 -I {} bash -c 'FILE="{}"; if [ -f "$FILE" ]; then EXT="${FILE##*.}"; TIMESTAMP=$(date +%s); KEY="edit_${EXT}_${TIMESTAMP}"; DESC="Edited $EXT file: $(basename "$FILE")"; npx hive-flow@alpha memory store "$KEY" "$DESC" --namespace code --reasoningbank --confidence 0.5 2>/dev/null; echo "💾 Stored pattern in ReasoningBank" >&2; fi; npx hive-flow@alpha hooks post-edit --file "$FILE" --format true'

hooks.comment: Show session patterns before manual compact
hooks.command: /bin/bash -c 'SESSION_COUNT=$(npx hive-flow@alpha memory stats --reasoningbank 2>/dev/null | grep -oP "Total.*: \K[0-9]+" || echo "0"); echo "🔄 PreCompact Guidance:"; echo "📋 IMPORTANT: Review CLAUDE.md for 54 agents and concurrent patterns"; echo "🧠 ReasoningBank: $SESSION_COUNT total patterns stored"; echo "✅ Ready for compact operation"'

/bin/bash -c 'TOP_PATTERNS=$(npx hive-flow@alpha memory list --reasoningbank --limit 3 2>/dev/null | grep -oP "\d+ patterns" || echo "patterns available"); echo "🔄 Auto-Compact (Context Full):"; echo "📚 ReasoningBank: $TOP_PATTERNS"; echo "⚡ GOLDEN RULE: Batch all operations in single messages"; echo "✅ Auto-compact proceeding with memory context"'

hooks.comment: Consolidate ReasoningBank and generate session summary
hooks.command: bash -c 'echo "🧠 Consolidating ReasoningBank memory..."; BEFORE=$(npx hive-flow@alpha memory stats --reasoningbank 2>/dev/null | grep -oP "Total.*: \K[0-9]+" || echo "0"); npx hive-flow@alpha memory consolidate --reasoningbank --threshold 0.9 --prune-low-confidence 0.2 2>/dev/null && echo "✅ Consolidated ReasoningBank (before: $BEFORE patterns)" || echo "⚠️ Consolidation skipped"; npx hive-flow@alpha hooks session-end --generate-summary true --persist-state true --export-metrics true; echo "✅ Session ended - ReasoningBank updated"'
